data.name: Siddaraju
data.long_meaning: One who masters the auspicious and the inauspicious; one who has the power to bestow blessings.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and wisdom to overcome challenges and attain spiritual growth.

in_sanskrit.name: Siddaraju
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Auspicious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Siddaraju एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who masters the auspicious and the inauspicious; one who has the power to bestow blessings.

in_hindi.name: सिद्धराजू
in_hindi.long_meaning: सिद्ध (Siddh) - पूर्ण (Pūrṇa) कर्ता (Kartā) या पूर्ण कर्मवान (Karmavān) के साथ राजा (Rājā) हुआ व्यक्ति (Vyakti)। (A person who has accomplished or completed all tasks or duties and is therefore a king.)

in_tamil.name: Siddaraju
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of the Auspicious
in_tamil.long_meaning: Siddaraju ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who masters the auspicious and the inauspicious; one who has the power to bestow blessings.

in_telugu.name: Siddaraju
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of the Auspicious
in_telugu.long_meaning: Siddaraju ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who masters the auspicious and the inauspicious; one who has the power to bestow blessings.

in_marathi.name: Siddaraju
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Auspicious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddaraju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who masters the auspicious and the inauspicious; one who has the power to bestow blessings.

in_bengali.name: Siddaraju
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Auspicious
in_bengali.long_meaning: Siddaraju একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who masters the auspicious and the inauspicious; one who has the power to bestow blessings.

data.cultural_impact: The name Siddaraju is commonly found in Karnataka, India, especially among the Veerashaiva Lingayat community. It is a combination of two Kannada words, "Siddha" meaning one who has mastered or ____ (completed a significant spiritual journey), and "Raju" meaning one who rules or possesses power. In the Hindu cultural context, Siddaraju is often considered a revered figure who has obtained spiritual mastery and possesses the power to bestow blessings upon others. This name carries an atmosphere of respect, authority, and divine grace.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Siddaraju signifies one who has transcended the limitations of the material world and attained a state of enlightenment. The prefix "Siddha" suggests that the individual has achieved spiritual mastery and has the ability to influence the course of events in the world through their actions and words. The suffix "Raja," meaning rule or reign, implies that this spiritual master has the power to govern the mind and emotions and to direct the course of one's spiritual journey towards God or Self Realization. Therefore, Siddaraju is a name that inspires us to strive for spiritual growth, mastery, and enlightenment, while reminding us of the power and potential that resides within each one of us.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Siddaraju: One who is blessed with the grace of the Siddas (enlightened masters), attaining inner peace and spiritual growth. The name signifies a continuous journey towards self-realization.
